title: The Fast Fourier Transform
bodyHtml:
The Fast Fourier Transform

The 'prism' for decomposing digital signals.

What is it?

FFT accelerates the DFT from O(n^2) to O(n log n).

Applications

  • Predictive maintenance (vibration)
  • Sleep motion analysis
  • Audio fingerprinting

sections.hook: How does Shazam identify a song? FFT acts like a 'prism' for sound, splitting a signal into its frequencies.

discovery.name: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)
discovery.explanationHtml: FFT accelerates the DFT from O(n^2) to O(n log n), enabling real-time spectral analysis.
